m10.text: Sarkhan Vol appears among the planeswalkers, declaring that rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison.

m12.text: Sarkhan Vol is remembered as one of Bolas's long-term collected relationships, having become Sarkhan the Mad just as Tezzeret the Seeker became Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas.

ktk.text: Sarkhan Vol, a Mardu general, is touched by an ancient dragon spirit, sacrifices his men in a massive spell and ascends as a planeswalker, leaving Tarkir.
Years later he returns to Tarkir in disgrace, mind unraveling, after realizing Bolas had treated him as a mere pawn, and he begins to hear a voice telling him to find the doorway.
Narset takes him to the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon, but Zurgo, who calls him a traitor, attacks there and kills Narset while she urges Sarkhan into the Nexus of Fate.
Sarkhan travels 1,280 years back in time and encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon, saving him and creating the current timeline, in which Ugin's sleep brings stronger dragon tempests.

frf.text: Sarkhan Vol steps through the flaming gate onto a snowy Temur tundra, grieving Narset and discovering that Ugin's voice in his head has gone silent.

Dragons emerge from a luminous storm, and he realizes the gate has taken him to Tarkir's past, where he follows a brood and begins to transform before a warrior woman and her sabertooth kill two fledglings.
He meets Yasova Dragonclaw, who is guided by a golden dragon's voice, and realizes that the voice is Bolas, who is coming to kill Ugin.
Sarkhan flies off in dragon form to protect Ugin, and after Bolas fights Ugin, he activates the hedron around the dying dragon, preserving him and rewriting history.

dtk.text: Sarkhan Vol defies Yasova, breathes on a hedron shard to wrap Ugin in a restorative cocoon, and is whisked away by temporal forces.
He returns to a changed Tarkir where mighty dragons rule the skies, but Zurgo, Taigam and the others do not know him and he learns Narset is no more.
Resolving to wake Ugin, he finds the cocoon crumbled and Ugin alive, and learns that in this history he was never born.
He also finds this timeline's Narset, who does not know him, and both are content to remain on Tarkir.

tdm.text: Sarkhan Vol emerges at the Crucible, saying all of the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons, but Elspeth easily defeats him and Narset blasts him down when he tries to stab her in the back.
Wounded and humiliated, he limps back to Mardu territory, where Taigam offers him a way to regain his draconic form.
Under Taigam's direction he hunts a young dragon, cuts out its heart and bites into it, becoming an enormous dragon who takes control of the wild dragons at the borders.
Vowing to bathe the Multiverse in fire, he fights Elspeth in the sky until Ugin burns him with ghostfire and Sarkhan dives away through the storm.
